doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

title: Pause, wrapping up, and the documentary project
summary: Monk suggests a break; they mention a documentary about them awaiting funding.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Why don’t we take a pause for just a second. It’s 4:30. I don’t know if you’re in a great hurry.
Well we might have to come back later so we can live more of our live together. We’re almost caught up here, well not quite.

We can wrap up, I don’t know if there was anything particularly that you would like to get on tape. Because Roy was telling me that you’re working on a documentary yourself, and if there’s anything that you’d like to talk about, we could talk about it.
We are right now, it’s at a standstill because we’re waiting to get some money. Because the people who are doing it, we have nothing to do with it that way.

This is somebody who we know who is a friend who respects and likes what we do, and so she’s trying — they’ve done it so far on their own money, and it’s been — we had one good session interview, but she wants to do a lot more things so they’re trying to get a grant or something.
Yeah, they’re trying to get some money.
They’re trying to get some money from Herb Wong.
I had mentioned this to Monk.
